corrections.summary: The comparison load treated every 409 as no_previous_diagnosis. A draft id opened at comparar/:id gets 409 diagnosis_not_completed from the server, which showed 'Ainda não há o que comparar'. The check now matches error.code === "no_previous_diagnosis" (ApiError exposes code, httpClient.ts:27), so other 409s fall through to the generic retryable error state.
